description: Source code implementing a client-side SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication protocol, including functions for initializing a client, generating a public key, setting a password, deriving a session key, verifying responses, and closing the client context.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client context with username, parameters, and salt after validation.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a public key (A) for the SRP protocol based on a random private exponent.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Computes verifier values (p and v) from username, password, and salt.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Derives the session key from server's public value and client parameters.

methods.name: t_clientverify
methods.description: Verifies server response against expected hash.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Clears sensitive data and frees the client context.
